test.gtk: GTK 2.24.33 real GtkTreeView widgets under private Xvfb
test.method: GTK2 RC widget-name selector applied to one named TreeView; pixel samples read from the rendered GTK2 root capture. The peer TreeView retained the normal KDE View role.
test.derived_color: #2a80a9 (RGB [42,128,169]); generated from the active KDE role for this private test only

decision: GTK2's RC widget-name selector can isolate a contextual style when the application assigns a unique widget name. A class selector such as GtkTreeView would be global to matching lists. The VUE app-default resources do not establish that any target GTK application exposes a corresponding unique widget name, so do not add the candidate color to the global GtkTreeView/list recipe. No product/theme source or user configuration changed.
limits: The fixture proves GTK2 selector behavior, not that an actual target application assigns a stable name to its File Finder list.
The two pixel samples prove isolated face painting only; they do not compare list geometry, selected rows, focus, font, or scrollbar policy.
The GTK2 Style base array was not readable through this PyGObject introspection build; the test used rendered pixel samples instead.
next: Keep only I167/GTK2 active. Do not change the global list recipe from this application-specific hypothesis. Move to a distinct GTK2 state with an available SR10.4 comparison, retaining the open questions about selection and application-level mapping.
